t: What is buprenorphine? A Q&A about King County’s new bup hotline – PUBLIC HEALTH INSIDER
s: April 17, 2024 - Thanks to a new 24/7 ‘bup’ prescribing hotline, it's easier than ever for people in King County to get started on medication to treat opioid use disorder. In partnership with the UW Department of Emergency Medicine, King County recently launched a telemedicine program that will provide on-demand access to a buprenorphine prescription, also known as “bup”.
